Chéri, on est deux dêh. Et moi, tu me paies pas.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The client, her face turned three-quarters to the camera, asks seriously. The boss answers with a huge confident smile, arms spread wide. The wife leans on her mop and says her line to her husband, her face clearly visible.
chute: The client slowly turns her head toward the wife and her mop, then back to the boss; the boss's huge smile freezes. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boss's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA CLIENTE EN REPRENANT SON ACOMPTE :
mecanisme: vantardise démolie par l'épouse : double cible, le mensonge et le salaire impayé

lieu: boss's office of a small construction company in Koumassi, Abidjan, a desk with an open empty metal cash box, a child's drawing on the wall, a small chair beside the desk, Saturday morning

persos.desc: worker, a man in his 40s, emerald-and-burgundy overalls, strong arms and a tired face, holding ONE single safety helmet
persos.pose: standing on the right, holding the helmet, angry

persos.desc: boss, a man in his 40s, indigo-and-aubergine polo, round face and small moustache, both hands on the empty cash box
persos.pose: sitting behind the desk in the foreground on the left, both hands on the open empty cash box, pitiful

persos.desc: boy around 8, mint-and-cream tracksuit, big innocent eyes, holding ONE single inflatable swim ring
persos.pose: sitting on the small chair in the middle beside the desk, the swim ring on his lap, cheerful

dialogue: Patron, encore pas de salaire ce mois-ci ?!
Mon vieux, la caisse est vide. On a rien dêh.
Papa, et notre nouvelle piscine-là ?
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The worker, his face turned three-quarters to the camera, raises the helmet and shouts. The boss tilts the empty cash box toward him with a pitiful face. The boy looks up at his father with a big innocent smile and says his line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The boss freezes, a fake smile stuck on his face; the worker slowly puts his free hand on his hip. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boss's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LES EMPLOYÉS SAMEDI AVEC LEURS MAILLOTS :
mecanisme: révélation innocente de l'enfant qui démolit le mensonge du patron

lieu: recruitment office of a hotel in Adjamé, Abidjan, a desk with a pile of CVs, a pen holder, a potted plant, morning

persos.desc: recruiter, a woman in her 50s, teal-and-cream kaba, reading glasses and short grey hair, holding ONE single letter with a banknote stapled to it
persos.pose: sitting behind the desk on the right, holding up the letter, amused

persos.desc: candidate, a man in his 30s, mustard-and-pistachio shirt, big proud smile, hands empty
persos.pose: sitting on a chair in the foreground on the left, chest out, proud

dialogue: Ton ancien patron a écrit : prenez-le, je vous en supplie !
Tu vois, Tantie ? Il veut mon bonheur dêh.
Mon petit, il a agrafé dix mille francs dessus.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The recruiter, her face turned three-quarters to the camera, reads the letter aloud, eyebrows raised. The candidate answers proudly, one hand on his chest. The recruiter turns the letter to show the stapled banknote and says her line, her face clearly visible.
chute: The candidate's proud smile slowly melts as he stares at the banknote. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the candidate's crushed face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: L'ANCIEN PATRON EN POSTANT LA LETTRE :
mecanisme: fausse recommandation retournée : la preuve finale montre qu'on a payé pour se débarrasser de lui
